name: Tufts University
meets_full_need_notes: Tufts meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted domestic undergraduates. The university is committed to affordability, with significant increases in need-based aid over the past decade.
no_loan_notes: Tufts does not have a no-loan policy. Federal loans are included in most aid packages. However, Tufts has reduced loan expectations for low-income families and replaced some loan components with grants.
ed_aid_implications: Tufts offers Early Decision (binding). Aid packages are identical under ED and Regular Decision. Students should run the Net Price Calculator before applying ED to estimate their award.
special_programs: Tufts Legacy Scholarship (for children of alumni with financial need)
appeal_policy: Tufts students may appeal their financial aid package through the Financial Aid Office by submitting a Special Circumstances Appeal form with supporting documentation.
